I read the landlord's notice and raised your scheduled rent payment (ID 7) from 1,100.00 to 1,200.00, which covers the 100.00 increase. I left the date (2022-04-04), the recipient and the subject unchanged.

The notice says the increase starts "next month" but doesn't give a date. The new amount applies to the payment already scheduled for 2022-04-04. If the increase should start with a later payment, tell me and I'll change it.
